name: Unknown
source:
An Unknown number that keeps calling. A conversation with a stranger. Are you safe in your own home?

Unknown is a visual novel horror game focusing on an obsessive interaction with a stalker. Play as yourself as you navigate a phone call with this stranger that seems to know more about you then you do of him. Do your best to escape the situation that takes place next. 

[From [url=https://bondagebunny.itch.io/unknown]Itch.io[/url]]
